label: Effective number of bits
subgoals: Measure SNDR with a full-scale sine
Quote ENOB at a stated input frequency

label: The Walden figure of merit
subgoals: Divide power by two to the ENOB times the sample rate
Express the result in femtojoules per conversion step

label: The Schreier figure of merit
subgoals: Use half the sample rate as the bandwidth for a Nyquist converter
Add ten log ten of bandwidth over power to the SNDR
Choose Walden or Schreier by whether the design is matching- or noise-limited
